backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing PDF upload (chunked), metadata storage, user profiles, and access control using mixins for authorization and blob storage.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing two features: fixing the GalleryPage 'Open' button navigation and verifying ViewerPage shareId param handling and PDF retrieval flow.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document summarizing each frontend source file's purpose, covering styles, hooks, components, and pages for the PDF Share app.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS entry file defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes including colors, borders, and sidebar tokens.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell with a root div and a module script entry point loading the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines the TanStack Router setup with routes for /, /gallery, /upload, /dashboard, and /view/:shareId, wrapped in a shared Header/Footer layout.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying copyright year and a caffeine.ai attribution link with UTM parameters.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky navigation header with logo, nav links (Gallery, Upload, Dashboard), and Internet Identity login/logout button with React Query cache clearing.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using React Query, reinitializing and invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout state and persisting identity across page reloads using DFINITY's AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines TanStack Query hooks for all backend interactions including listing, fetching, uploading (chunked), deleting, and renaming PDFs via the actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Google Fonts, configures Tailwind CSS with a dark navy/amber color palette via CSS custom properties, and defines reusable component utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrapping the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Dashboard page displaying the authenticated user's uploaded PDFs in a list with inline title editing, share link copying, and delete confirmation functionality.
frontend/src/pages/GalleryPage.tsx: Public gallery page that displays all shared PDFs in a responsive card grid with loading skeletons, error, and empty states, navigating to the viewer on click.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Marketing landing page with a hero section, call-to-action buttons linking to upload and dashboard, and a three-step 'How it works' feature grid.
frontend/src/pages/UploadPage.tsx: React page for uploading PDF files in chunks (500KB each) to the backend, requiring Internet Identity authentication. Handles drag-and-drop file selection, chunked upload progress, finalization, and displays a shareable link on success.
frontend/src/pages/ViewerPage.tsx: React page that fetches PDF metadata by shareId and streams the PDF binary via XHR with progress tracking, rendering it in an iframe using a blob URL. Includes a top navigation bar with back/next PDF links and loading/error states.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL query parameters from both regular and hash-based routing, persisting them to sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive parameters from the URL hash without page reload.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with dark mode, custom OKLCH-based color tokens, extended font families (Inter, Space Grotesk), border radii, box shadows, and keyframe animations for accordion and fade effects.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file (version 15) describing a PDF-sharing website built on the Internet Computer, listing existing features, known issues (chunked upload failures, auth rejections, PDF viewer bugs), and architectural notes about IC's 2MB ingress limit.
